title: Amanda Knox Trial: 5 Key Questions
overview: A look at the trial centered on U.S. exchange student Amanda Knox, whose British roommate and fellow student was found brutally slain in their home. It examines the legal case surrounding the 2007 murder of British student Meredith Kercher in Perugia, Italy, focusing on the evidence and the major questions raised during the retrial of Amanda Knox and Raffaele Sollecito.
